name: Circle of Death
summary: Releases a 60-foot-radius Sphere of negative energy that deals Necrotic damage.

m.text: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP

stats.effect: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere from a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 6.
